描述_EN: Broad satin with cockerel motif on blue ground，reign name of Qing emperor Guangxu or Guang-hsu (1875-1908)，width73centimetre。　　This fabric is organized in a magenta blue eight-part warp satin pattern.，in white、lilac (color)、capital of the Jin State during the Spring and Autumn Period (770-475 BC)、rose purple、fruit green、Golden and other colorful velvet is woven by shuttle weaving.。The main pattern of the fabric is two fighting roosters.，with diamond-shaped floral motifs。The patterns are continuously interlaced in the latitudinal direction。　　Canton satin is produced in Guangdong Province, China,together with the famous“Cantonese embroidery”Craftwork like，With a strong Lingnan style。Unique presentation of wide satin，Extremely decorative，The outline of the pattern、neat and clear lines，The color scheme is vibrant yet busy and uncluttered。Patterns are generally small、piecemeal，But the outline of the pattern、Natural and neat lines。Contrasting colors are often used in the color scheme，Creates a luminous and passionate visual effect。
描述_ZN: A tiger talisman of the Warring States, 8 cm long and 3.6 cm high.　　It was used in the State of Qi during the Warring States period. The tiger amulet should be in two halves, which are combined into the shape of a crouching tiger. The right half is extant. It has a tiger-shaped tail with a perforated hole in the tail, an inscription with two lines and 11 characters on the front, and two concave dots on the back. The inscription reads from left to right and is interpreted as follows: "Fill (Ying) Qiu Ya (with) small mound 䋣 for Pei Dafu Xinjie". "Fill the mound".
